descriptions.d25i_weapon_list_fill_b_801100ac: Fill a settings list, as 0x8010fd08 but with the list table at +64 and only definitions of group +44 equal to 1: resolves the list object, empties its value array, creates the label table (class 0x80419e68), walks the settings and appends name and shared text for each kind 5 setting of type 0x803667a8, then attaches the table.
